ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to human review: obtain the trip call recording and any road-specific agreement, and verify the traffic state on the replaced AYE stretch at 18:42–18:55 against the band-2 link; if the general assent is held not to cover the off-route loop and no traffic reason is confirmed, refund the excess distance fare (~$7.80) and record the driver violation under RD-2/RD-7.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, the driver's statement and the chat logs contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is route_deviation. safety_concern = none.

Substance (route deviation). Recommended distance 24.445 km; actual 29.98 km; deviation 5.535 km, well over the 1 km tolerance (RD-1). The GPS track runs the recommended roads (Jalan Boon Lay, Ayer Rajah Expressway, Central Expressway, Merchant Road, Pickering/Church, Marina Boulevard, Sheares Avenue, ECP, Temasek Boulevard) — the record's off-route portion is the Clementi/Kent Ridge/Pasir Panjang/South Buona Vista loop driven roughly 18:43–18:56 (Clementi West St 1, West Coast Road, Clementi Road, Kent Ridge Crescent, Arts Link, Kent Ridge Drive, Pasir Panjang Road, South/North Buona Vista Road, before rejoining the AYE), which the recommended route does not use.

Key element in dispute: consent / notice (RD-5). The driver's message at 18:41:20 tells the rider traffic is building on the AYE and asks "shall I take another way?" — but it names no road or route. The rider replied at 18:42:00 "Just take whichever way is faster lah, I'm late," i.e. a general "any faster way is fine". The first off-route movement begins at about 18:43:15 as the vehicle leaves the AYE onto Clementi West Street 1, so the assent was given before the segment began and the segment is not an uninformed reroute. However, the rider's own complaint says any faster way was fine yet "the meter ended up well above the estimate" and "I don't think it was faster at all" — the only stated condition on the assent (that the alternative be faster) is in the rider's own words disputed on the record.

Policy application turns on whether this general assent qualifies as "rider agreed to go via X" under RD-5. RD-3/RD-5 make a rider-named place or route, once accepted, non-deviation; a bare "take whichever way is faster" names no road, so the RD-5 road-name check cannot be run ("No road names in the record → escalate"). RD-4 also cannot be resolved: the traffic_speed_bands log gives an AYE band-2 window 18:23:15–18:55:15 that covers the replaced part of the route, which would support a traffic reason for the off-route segment, but the AYE stretch the driver in fact avoided (around 18:42–18:55) was being driven at ~71–74 km/h, and no congestion, incident or closure is shown on the recommended route near the point of departure within 300 m. The traffic_conditions array is empty, so the traffic-reason question under RD-4 is not settled by a record that would favour either side.

Because the applicability of RD-3/RD-5 (and hence whether the off-route km are exempt or refundable) and of RD-4 turns on evidence the record does not settle — no road names in the consent exchange and a contradictory traffic picture (band-2 AYE link vs. actual high speeds, empty traffic_conditions) — I do not manufacture a refund figure. Under TH-4, a missing/undecidable outcome-relevant condition is escalated rather than presumed. This is a human-review case, so cited_policy includes RD-5 and TH-4.

If a reviewer determines the general consent does not cover the off-route route, the refund, computed at the trip's per-km distance fare ($42.27 / 29.98 km = $1.41/km) × 5.535 km ≈ $7.80; if it is treated as exempt, the charge stands. Tolls, time fare and platform fee are not refunded (RD-2).
ruling.escalation_reason: Route-deviation amount turns on whether the general 'whichever way is faster' assent covers the off-route segment (RD-3/RD-5) and whether a traffic reason applied (RD-4); both are undecidable on the record — no road names appear in the consent exchange, and traffic evidence is contradictory (band-2 AYE link vs ~71–74 km/h actual speeds, empty traffic_conditions). Per TH-4, missing/undecidable outcome-relevant records are escalated rather than presumed. Potential refund if the segment counts: ~$7.80 (5.535 km × $1.41/km).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment ~18:43–18:56 via Clementi West Street 1, West Coast Road, Clementi Road, Kent Ridge Crescent, Arts Link, Kent Ridge Drive, Pasir Panjang Road and South/North Buona Vista Road, rejoining the AYE at ~18:56. The driver's 18:41:20 notice ('shall I take another way?') preceded the segment and the rider assented at 18:42:00 ('whichever way is faster'), but the assent names no road and the driver's notice names no road, so the RD-5 road-name check cannot be run (RD-5: no road names → escalate) and RD-3 cannot be automatically applied. Traffic picture is contradictory: the AYE band-2 window 18:23:15–18:55:15 supports a traffic reason (RD-4), but the avoided AYE stretch was driven at ~71–74 km/h and traffic_conditions is empty. Exempt vs. counts cannot be determined on the record.

element_findings.element: RD-5 consent to the off-route segment
element_findings.reason: Driver's 18:41:20 'shall I take another way?' names no road; rider's 18:42:00 reply 'Just take whichever way is faster lah' is a general assent, and RD-5 provides that where no road names appear in the record the segment is escalated. The rider's own complaint that the route was not faster leaves the only stated condition unresolved on the record.

element_findings.element: RD-4 traffic reason for the off-route segment
element_findings.reason: traffic_conditions is empty; the only traffic record is an AYE band-2 window (18:23:15–18:55:15) which covers the replaced route, but the driver's own AYE travel at that time was ~71–74 km/h and no incident/closure is shown near the departure point.

ruling.evidence_gap: Consent/route-naming evidence: the consent exchange (driver 18:41:20, rider 18:42:00) names no road or route, so the RD-5 road-name check cannot be performed; and the traffic evidence is contradictory/missing — traffic_conditions is empty while traffic_speed_bands records an AYE band-2 window overlapping the affected period but actual AYE speeds of ~71–74 km/h, leaving the RD-4 traffic reason undecidable. No call recording or timed road-specific agreement exists in the record.
